purpose: Determine whether the q8 WebGPU browser candidate can execute a fixed synthetic input of exactly 1024 total tokens repeatedly in one browser/model session before any 1024-token browser ranking-parity experiment.

selection_provenance.prior_q8_feasibility_observation: 512 tokens passed; 2048 tokens failed with table index is out of bounds; 4096 was not run
selection_provenance.prior_q8_512_warm_result: passed 6/6 finite forwards at exact 512 tokens
selection_provenance.python_1024_development_result: passed preregistered 50/50 exact Top-10 membership equivalence versus 4096 on the frozen development pool
selection_provenance.why_1024: 1024 is the next unobserved runtime point between the known successful exact-512 q8 case and the known failed exact-2048 q8 case, and is the truncation length that passed the separate Python development structural-equivalence gate

synthetic_input_contract.base_query: What is the relation between being and knowledge?
synthetic_input_contract.base_document: Synthetic runtime feasibility document. This input exists only to exercise the browser runtime and is not part of any ranking evaluation.
synthetic_input_contract.construction: Use the pinned tokenizer and the same synthetic prompt contract as the prior q8 feasibility and 512-warm experiments. Insert the preregistered one-token filler until total input length is exactly 1024 tokens.

requirements: all six forwards complete without runtime exception
every input contains exactly 1024 total tokens
every score is finite and in [0,1]
primary_gate.pass_rule: All 6 of 6 forwards must pass. Latency is observational only in this experiment.

failure_policy.after_failure: Freeze any produced outputs, update EXPERIMENT_LOG.md, and preregister any subsequent runtime candidate separately.

success_policy.next_step: If and only if all six exact-1024 forwards pass, preregister a separate browser q8 versus frozen Python-1024 numerical/ranking-parity experiment. Do not automatically access the fresh ranking holdout or change production.
